nodes.label: GitHub Clone Flow
nodes.rationale: graphify clone places repos under ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo> and reuses existing clones on repeat runs, returning a local path that every subsequent pipeline step targets.

nodes.label: Cross-Repo Graph Merge
nodes.rationale: Each repo or subfolder is built separately then merged with merge-graphs, every node carrying a repo attribute for filtering. For monorepo subfolders the CLI must be used directly rather than the skill pipeline, because the skill writes all outputs to graphify-out/ in the cwd and running it per subfolder would clobber the same directory.

edges.source_location: Once graphify-out/graph.json exists, the fast path above takes over
